final_text:
I attempted to download the resume template from the link provided on the website, but the download was blocked by a security policy because the file is hosted on a different domain (`resume-templates-portal.com`) than the main site (`resume-templates.com`).

As a result, I am unable to download the file directly. You may need to download it manually from the following link and move it to your `/documents` folder:
https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template.pdf
